L: L cone signal: the light weighted by the long wavelength cones' sensitivity and added over all wavelengths
M: M cone signal: the light weighted by the middle wavelength cones' sensitivity and added over all wavelengths
S: S cone signal: the light weighted by the short wavelength cones' sensitivity and added over all wavelengths; S(λ) is the spectrum, the power per unit wavelength reaching the eye
bar l: Sensitivity of the L cones at wavelength λ
bar m: Sensitivity of the M cones at wavelength λ
bar s: Sensitivity of the S cones at wavelength λ
